look_here_first: LOOK FIRST at a fully mature anthocarp under magnification: conspicuous stalked-glandular hairs and rounded longitudinal ribs favor B. coccinea. Then confirm perennial growth and leaves continuing up the stems; do not key from reddish flower color.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Small clustered flowers and ribbed anthocarps; a petaloid perianth without a separate true corolla.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Mature anthocarps about 2.6–4 mm, densely stalked-glandular, with rounded ribs.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Perennial habit, leaves distributed along the stems; flower color is variable.
